caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a natural woven seat. The chair is constructed from polished wood, presenting a reddish-brown color throughout the frame, including the arms, legs, and decorative backrest. The backrest features a wide, curved top rail and a single central splat with a vase or shield-like shape, connecting to the seat rail. Both armrests are made of wood, curving slightly outward with smooth, rounded edges. The legs and supporting stretchers of the chair are turned, with each leg featuring several rounded bulges and narrow segments. Horizontal stretchers connect the legs on all four sides for additional support. The seat is a light, natural color, woven in a tight, diagonal pattern, likely made of rush or reeds, contrasting with the wooden frame. The drawing is set against an off-white or cream-colored plain background, and the composition centers the chair, showing it at a slight angle to capture both the front and side view.
title: Armchair
